Name: No Watering Energy
Author: Twisle
Description:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/JCNq6bj.png[/img]
Yo, yo, yo! Pretty simple mod here for yall﻿. All this mod does is take away the engery cost when you use your watering can. Pretty simple pretty easy. Im not a fan of how it takes energy, so i created this and I mise well share it.


[img]https://i.imgur.com/e4b3WyH.png[/img]
[list]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Unzip the mod folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/uABfFuC.png[/img]
